scope: Real hash-verified Qwen3 4B/14B Q4_K_M, actual local application HTTP/SSE, synthetic text scenarios. No TTS/physical/human or generic semantic approval.

arms.stage_A: Current default generation, identity/profile/task/literal candidates all disabled; source/permission fixes retained. Development12 only, sequential models and fresh DB each scenario.
arms.stage_B: After reviewing complete native outputs, preregister a bounded candidate and analytic false-positive/negative gates before edits; candidate remains off by default.
arms.stage_C: Only after candidate freeze run prospective12 and paired application HTTP/SSE. Record raw provider replies, visible stream, final result, provenance and all failures; no deployment based on lexical pass alone.

gpu: At most one owned model provider at once; select by actual startup headroom/visible UUID, existing16GiB/24GiB gates, do not terminate other processes; record GPU allocation and owned shutdown.
assessment: Save every turn, not final turn only. Separate llm vs deterministic lookup/guard/fallback. Agent source-based span review distinguishes direct assistant claims, quoted/fictional/writing/negative/conditional/online/ambiguous; no model self-score or independent-human approval claim. Service fallback is infrastructure failure, not a quality pass.
